Subject: Northgate SI launch & enablement kick-off

Hi Elena / Ben —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. We're excited to get Northgate formally into the SI program and want to propose a short, pragmatic enablement plan so your consultants can sell and implement Redwood-powered features confidently. High level we recommend: 

- Week-of-June 15: two-day Trainer-led technical deep dive (runtime, VPC/private deploy, KMS, certs)
- Week-of-June 22: two half-day sales enablement sessions (value props, pricing levers, demo scripts)
- Self-serve materials: solutions brief, install checklist, sample manifests, and troubleshooting runbook

As next steps: can you confirm (1) a point-of-contact for training logistics, (2) whether your consultants need on-prem package or will stick to our Dedicated offering, and (3) procurement timeline for an initial pilot?

I'll loop in product enablement and engineering as we firm dates. Attaching an outline today (working draft).

Thanks —

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Jonas — this looks great and aligned with our priorities. A few quick notes: 

- Training POC: me (Elena) for sales scheduling, Ben for technical lead.
- We primarily use AWS in our pilots but occasionally run on-prem for regulated customers; we'll want clear docs for both Dedicated and Private deployment paths (especially VPC/KMS details).
- Procurement: aim for a pilot PO by end of June. I can loop in procurement once we have an MOU or statement of work.

Can you share the solutions brief and a concise "consultant quickstart" that we can hand to delivery leads? Also wondering if there are any hands-on labs or an emulated environment we can use for the deep-dive.

On availability: June 15 week works for a technical workshop; June 22 week is fine for sales sessions.

Best,

Elena / team —

Quick technical note and checklist to help your delivery leads prepare. I've attached the SI_Quickstart_Checklist.xlsx with checklist steps; highlights below: 

- Environments: Recommended staging cluster (1x A10g or T4 equivalent) + isolated test VPC for KV/cache testing.
- Networking: We provide a VPC peering guide and example terraform snippets. For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own) or Redwood KMS; procurement should list KMS key access and rotation windows.
- Auth: API key + optional mTLS for edge services; for deeper control we can enable Okta SAML provisioning.
- Training lab: we can provision a short-lived sandbox project for 10 consultants (30-day window) so they can run the end-to-end sample workload.

Please review the checklist and confirm anything specific you need us to include for your on-prem customers. Marissa — looping you in to capture sales enablement artifacts (solutions brief and playbook).

Thanks,

Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
Attachment: SI_Quickstart_Checklist.xlsx

- Partner value prop and 2-page solutions brief for consultants
- Implementation checklist (mirrors Ava's spreadsheet)
- Suggested training agenda + lab exercises
- Sales play + objection handling (pricing levers, fallbacks, and demo scripts)

We also prepared a short MOU to formalize a pilot commitment (DocuSign link below). If you confirm the pilot parameters (three clients, sandbox access, and one paid pilot month), we can sign and schedule the training.

Drive (playbook): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-Northgate-Enablement
HubSpot company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/9876543

1) You sign MOU (DocuSign)
2) We provision a sandbox and send calendar invites for the technical workshop (Ava + eng leads)
3) Sales enablement (Marissa) runs two half-days with your seller/AE teams

Questions for you: do you want Redwood to present the sales session to your account teams or co-deliver with a Northgate trainer? Also, any specific NDA/procurement language we should be aware of before the MOU?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.
